MANUFAKTUR X WTA

Made for this year’s WTA winner.

Some wins deserve more than a trophy. As the FAGE WTA Finals come to Indian Wells, California, for the first time, Mercedes-Benz marks the occasion with a truly unique winner’s car: the ultraviolet MANUFAKTUR Made to Measure Mercedes-AMG SL 55 4MATIC+, personal and beautifully crafted to celebrate an outstanding achievement.

G-Class

The new G-Class with EQ Technology.
The G 580 with EQ Technology is an exciting step forward into the world of electric cars, while still staying true to the iconic G-Class spirit. With its revolutionary electric performance, this vehicle combines the best of both worlds. Inside, you'll find a spacious cabin crafted with precision and premium materials, along with all the features you'd expect from an electric vehicle. It seamlessly blends timeless elegance with offroad functionality, making it a truly versatile choice. Speaking of offroad, the all-new electric G-Class delivers unyielding performance, with unique features like G-TURN for axis spins and G-STEERING for precise turns. This vehicle doesn't compromise - it's all about innovation and pushing boundaries.

Why all-electric?

Six reasons to choose an all-electric vehicle.

All-electric drive

Electrified by Mercedes-Benz.

The EQE and EQS from Mercedes-Benz use the new modular electric platform of the luxury and executive class as illustrated above. These are just the first two models to use the new platform, and they serve as examples for many more models to follow in the future. This fully scalable platform can be shared across all models, with wheelbase, track width, and system components such as batteries and drive units being variable thanks to its modular design.


 

Electric car charging

Mercedes-Benz charging solutions at home and on the go.

Revolutionise your electric mobility experience with Mercedes-Benz electric cars and our pioneering charging solutions. At the forefront of sustainable mobility, Mercedes-Benz offers a seamless and convenient charging ecosystem to optimise your journey. The Mercedes-Benz Wallbox impresses with its charging power, exclusive design and intelligent functionality. On the road, you can enjoy the freedom of our Mercedes me Charge service, which offers access to one of the world's largest public charging networks with just one charging contract including the Mercedes-Benz Charging Hubs.
Learn more

Safety

Fully protected: the all-electric vehicles by Mercedes-Benz.

Safety is also a priority in the fully electric models. All models, from EQA to EQS SUV, come equipped with a variety of safety features, designed to protect you before, during and after a potential hazard. Find the model that fits you and discover safety innovations by Mercedes-Benz.

Highlights

Highlights in our limousines.

Whether a sporty A-Class or a luxurious S-Class - all Mercedes-Benz limousines have something in common: their distinctive 3-box design, the unique comfort and high level of safety ensure that you reach your destination in a relaxed manner thanks to intelligent technologies.

The features could be applicable to specific models.

More information

This is what sets Mercedes-Benz limousines apart.

For more than 60 years, luxury Mercedes-Benz limousines have been providing elegance and relaxation on the road. In 1953, Mercedes-Benz presented the Model 180. The upper mid-range limousine was the first passenger car with a self-supporting body and 3-box design, and was considered a pioneer of automotive modernity. The Model 180 laid the foundation for all current Mercedes-Benz limousines. They continue to represent a sporty, elegant design and top-class comfort to the present day. Beyond this, since 2021, the consistently fully-electric luxury EQS limousines from Mercedes-Benz have been setting new standards for forward-looking design, innovative connectivity and fascinating everyday comfort.

Icons give you reasons to celebrate them. Time and again.

Thank you, India, for making the E-Class the most desirable luxury car. Over the past year, the E-Class has set benchmarks in the segment, winning an impressive 9 awards and becoming the definitive choice for luxury car buyers in India.

 

Here’s celebrating an evolving legacy with a new colour. Introducing the E-Class LWB, in Verde Silver.

Exterior

Exterior of the new E-Class LWB.

From the radiator shell to the elegantly dynamic rear end design with fascinating lighting details: the all new E-Class LWB speaks the language of exciting design and follows with the progressive stylistic elements that are characteristic of innovative dynamism. The split taillights impress with their new contour and an unmistakable star-look interior.

Interior

Interior of the new E-Class LWB.


The new E-Class sets new standards not just in terms of design. The latest-generation MBUX multimedia system ensures an even more personalised in-vehicle experience. Convenient functions, entertainment and everyday business features are intuitively and seamlessly linked. This is how the new E-Class offers you an even more pleasant, feel-good atmosphere — from the relaxing morning routine in the multicontour seat to the after-work playlist in Dolby® Atmos.

MANUFAKTUR

Your exclusive wishes. Our first-class manual craftmanship.
Every detail of the new E-Class Saloon proves that Mercedes-Benz understands something about manual craftmanship. Not only in terms of design, technology and efficiency, but also when it comes to high-quality, sophisticated individualisation. With the MANUFAKTUR label, you will discover even more personalised options. Experience fascination and luxury with exclusive paint finished, a special roof liner and high-quality trim elements.

Highlights

This makes our Mercedes-Benz SUV models special.

The SUV models from Mercedes-Benz are perfect for the city and off-road. They offer space for lots of adventures and room for daily life. They are functional and yet comfortable. As modern classics, they remain true to their roots and, at the same time, impress with the latest state of the art.

 

Selected highlights:

 

Generous space
MBUX multimedia system
4MATIC all-wheel drive and AIRMATIC air suspension
E-ACTIVE BODY CONTROL
High seating position for better all-round view
Various driving assistance systems for your safety

G-Class

Stronger than time.
Many years ago, engineers in Graz developed a totally new type of DNA. The DNA of an off-road vehicle: iconic, robust and virtually indestructible. They designed parts which continue to perform the very same functions to this day. Components which have given rise to a highly distinct character over generations. But the G-Class is not just in its element in off-road terrain. The off-roader is equally uncompromising on the tarmac. On the road, the vehicle offers a whole new level of dynamism and comfort for an off-roader and delivers the type of driving enjoyment with which G-Class drivers have long been familiar in off-road terrain.

Further highlights

Classic off-road genes, urban technologies.
In addition to the all-electric EQE SUV, the compact SUVs, GLA and EQB, are also available. SUVs from Mercedes-Benz also offer the latest technologies. Discover the highlights now:

Digital Extras
MBUX multimedia system
Wireless charging system

Q & A

Frequently asked questions
The right Mercedes-Benz SUV exists for everyone – from the compact GLA and the versatile GLB to the striking GLC, the intelligent GLE and the luxurious full-size SUV GLS – not to mention the legendary G-Class. Space for more

Highlights

The highlights of the new Mercedes-AMG GLC Coupé.
Exterior

Visibly sporty from every angle, the bonnet with coat of arms and dark-chrome vertical-fin radiator trim is framed by the AMG-specific front apron and DIGITAL LIGHT, while the AMG-specific rear end with diffuser board and an AMG exhaust system featuring two round double tailpipe trim elements completes the sporty statement.

  
AMG RIDE CONTROL suspension

Comfortable cruising or sporty driving: Thanks to the AMG RIDE CONTROL suspension with adaptive adjustable damping, the choice is yours.

  
Performance experienced in its entirety: the interior

The exclusive interior of the new Mercedes-AMG GLC Coupé unites dynamic sportiness with generous space, outstanding everyday suitability and an innovative operating concept.

  
AMG illuminated door sills with "AMG" lettering

Sporty, exclusive statement thanks to door sill panels made of brushed stainless steel with a white illuminated "AMG" lettering.

  
Performance

The 310 kW (421 hp) AMG engine is supported by an electric exhaust gas turbocharger, which guarantees a particularly spontaneous response and dynamic driving experience over the entire rpm range. The starter-alternator delivers an additional boost of 10 kW (14 hp) in defined driving situations.

Highlights

The highlights of the new G-Class.
EXCLUSIVE Line Interior

Elegant equipment line, including such features as extended upholstery in nappa leather, ambient lighting for the air vents and the Burmester® 3D surround sound system.

  
AMG Line Exterior

Sporty Line, including powerful AMG Bodystyling, 20-inch AMG light-alloy wheels and multifunction sports steering wheel in nappa leather.

  
Updated radiator grille design

The G-Class captures attention immediately with its robust and efficient front design, a symbol of its readiness for new adventures. Its iconic stature is amplified by the newly designed radiator grille and the refined body kit.

  
Manufaktur Running boards in Chrome

With the MANUFAKTUR running boards in black, you can highlight the individuality and dynamism of your Mercedes-Benz G-Class even further. Other selective black accents are the black painted roof, bumpers and flared wheel arches in black - or you can choose a complete black finish.

  
100% differential locks

The 3 selectable differential locks with 100% locking effect ensure traction and propulsion, even in extreme off-road situations.

Highlights

The highlights of the new Mercedes-AMG A-Class Hatchback.
Exterior

Developed in the wind tunnel: The AMG Aerodynamics Package optimises handling characteristics at high speeds and lays the foundation for even more riding pleasure, with AMG-specific radiator shell, AMG Night Package and AMG front apron with air inlets and flics in high-gloss black for targeted air flow.

  
Interior

A motorsport-inspired interior featuring AMG performance seats with multi-contour support, fully electric adjustment, and seat heating.

  
AMG Driver's Package

Pushes the boundaries: The AMG Driver's Package increases the top speed to 270 km/h. Your vehicle thus emphasises its athletic claim and offers you pure fascination as well as impressive power reserves that you can feel on every open stretch of road.

  
AMG suspension

Feel the road, control the bend: The AMG suspension is consistently designed for high cornering speeds with minimal body roll.

Highlights

This makes the Mercedes-Benz coupés special.
The Mercedes-Benz coupés inspire with their avant-garde interior and state-of-the-art operation. This is matched by the urge to constantly evolve and to make every ride safer and more relaxed using assistance systems. The Mercedes-AMG GT 63 S E Performance 4-Door Coupé boasts a distinctive design and a sporty interior, providing an exclusive and thrilling driving experience. The intelligent MBUX system enhances the overall driving pleasure, making it a perfect blend of style and performance.

Impressive at all times

From exclusive top-class sports cars to innovators.
Coupés from Mercedes-Benz have always embodied elegance on four wheels. They have long since ceased to be available simply as exclusive luxury-class sports cars. Since the end of the 1960s they have also formed an integral part of the mid-range model series.

Further highlights

Fascination has many facets.
Today, Mercedes-Benz coupés offer more than just expressive design and dynamic handling. They also offer modern digital technologies.

Highlights

The highlights of the new Mercedes-AMG CLE Coupé.
AMG-specific radiator grille

A confident appearance from the very first moment: dynamically tilted front, AMG-specific radiator trim and striking AMG front apron.

  
AMG-specific rear

Distinctive and unmistakable: with two-part rear lamps, widely spaced rear wheels and retracted C-pillars, the rear looks visually wider and elegant at the same time.

  
50.8 cm (20-inch) AMG wheels

Choose out of various light alloy wheels in Y-spoke design, aerodynamically optimized, and forged wheels in cross-spoke design.

  
AMG DYNAMIC PLUS Package

Combines high-performance components for even more driving dynamics, such as AMG engine mounts and the “RACE” driving program.

  
Performance

The Mercedes-AMG CLE Coupé sets new standards and takes dynamic driving to a new level. Experience spontaneous reactions, precision you can feel, and supreme driving dynamics.

History

Cabriolets from Mercedes-Benz: traditionally innovative.
Constant evolution has been a feature of the history of the Mercedes-Benz cabriolets. "Cabriolet" originally meant a light, open carriage drawn by two horses. From about 1920 onwards, the term was used to refer to sporty vehicles with an open top. Daimler-Benz then developed the cabriolet types A to F: the predecessors of the current Mercedes-Benz cabriolets. Since then, they have become synonymous with elegant sports performance and outstanding weather protection.

Highlights

The highlights of the new V-Class.
More room to unwind

The Extra-Long Wheelbase variant features a 3,430 mm wheelbase, providing significantly increased legroom and cabin space.

  
AIRMATIC Suspension with (18-inch) 10-spoke light-alloy wheels

The AIRMATIC air suspension delivers an outstanding ride even over difficult terrain, using adaptive damping and automatic or individual vehicle‑level regulation that adjusts according to speed for optimal comfort and control. Complementing this system, the 18‑inch 10‑spoke light‑alloy wheels are precisely engineered to enhance handling safety, energy efficiency, and quiet running characteristics, ensuring a balanced and refined driving experience

  
Attuned to your senses

With the Energizing Comfort Package, eleven intuitive programmes orchestrate comfort in perfect balance. It seamlessly harmonizes climate, ambient lighting, sound and seat functions to create a tailored atmosphere for your every journey. Multi contour seats with ventilation and adjustable calf support in the second row offer tailored relaxation. The ventilated third-row seats extend the same refreshing composure, ensuring every passenger experiences the calm of the private suite.

  
Driver Camera

The driver camera is for your safety: it monitors your alertness and fitness at the wheel by monitoring your gaze direction and eye movement. Thanks to the interaction with ATTENTION ASSIST, you will receive visual and acoustic warning signals if any abnormalities are detected.

  
Airbags and active safety

The Mercedes-Benz V-Class EXTRA LWB comes equipped with 7 airbags as standard in addition to various active safety features which preempt and avoid collision in the first place.

Digital Extras

Your Mercedes-Benz. Our Digital Extras.
Unlock the full potential of your Mercedes-Benz: Your vehicle comes equipped with a variety of Digital Extras – tailored to your model, equipment, year of manufacture and country of purchase. Many of these services are available from the moment you drive off the lot. To continue enjoying them after the initial term, simply renew in the Mercedes-Benz Store. You can also explore and purchase additional Digital Extras at any time. Getting started is easy: register in the Mercedes-Benz Store with your Mercedes me ID and your Vehicle Identification Number (VIN). Access to the Store is only possible with your VIN – ensuring your car is identified correctly and allowing you to see exactly which Digital Extras are available for your vehicle, keeping it perfectly connected to the services that make every journey even more enjoyable.


Standard Equipment Digital Extras

Standard Equipment Digital Extras. Included in your Mercedes-Benz.
Our Standard Equipment Digital Extras are already installed in your Mercedes-Benz before you get in for the first time. To use these Standard Equipment Digital Extras, all you need to do is create a Mercedes me ID, agree to the Terms of Use, link your vehicle to your Mercedes-Benz account and download the Mercedes-Benz App on your smartphone.
Activate Standard Equipment

Digital Extras Packages

Digital Extras Packages. Benefits for you.
Get the upgrade for your Mercedes-Benz with our Digital Extras, and use your smartphone to remotely operate, customise and digitally add to your vehicle. This is because there's more in it for you at Mercedes-Benz. Many Digital Extras such as Remote, Navigation, Charging, GUARD 360˚ and Entertainment are already included from the time of purchase for a term of 36 months. The exact availability depends on your vehicle, the special equipment you have chosen, the year of manufacture and the country in which you live. Once the initial term has expired, you can easily and conveniently extend the desired Digital Extras in the Mercedes-Benz Store.

How to book Digital Extras – this is how it works.

Log in or register with your Mercedes me ID to experience our Digital Extras. Your personal Mercedes me ID is the key to the digital world of Mercedes-Benz and offers even more benefits beyond:


- Manage your vehicle and experience the world of Digital Services
- Receive personalized recommendations
- Edit your personal data and preferences
- Manage appointments at our Mercedes-Benz dealers

Mercedes-Benz Apps: Making the most of Digital Extras.
Log in to the Mercedes-Benz App with your personal Mercedes me ID and use all the advantages of our Digital Extras. The best connection to your Mercedes-Benz: The Mercedes-Benz App contains everything you need to know about your Digital Extras. The Mercedes-Benz Store App has now been integrated into the Mercedes-Benz App to make it even easier to use and bundle the applications.

Mercedes-Benz Approved Tyres and Alloys


Stay Mobile, and pave the way for possibilities


The quality and consistency your vehicle deserves


Maximize the safety and comfort with Mercedes-Benz Approved Tyres and Alloys, designed to optimally match your car’s safety systems as well as the model.
The robust side-wall for added strength are made for India, based on technical specifications.

 

Together in collaboration with Tyre manufacturers, we introduce a range of Mercedes-Benz Approved Tyres to our current product offering.
These tyres are made to match and designed to perform, comes with standard 5-year warranty support and are available at competitive prices.



Enjoy the convenience of changing your tyres when you visit any one of our Authorized Mercedes-Benz workshop nation wide.


Find the right kind of tire for your Mercedes-Benz.


Summer tires


Your benefits at a glance:

 

• Perfectly matched to your model of vehicle
• Optimum interplay between tires, road and suspension
• Optimum grip and traction
• High quality and comfortable ride characteristics

Mercedes Original-Tires make the difference.


As a Mercedes-Benz customer, you strive for the best driving experience. Five Mercedes Original-Tires (MO) were designed precisely for this purpose and developed in a design and testing phase of up to 1000 hours. They provide decisive advantages for the best possible performance:

 

• Perfectly matched: Specially developed, tested and adapted for the individual Mercedes-Benz vehicle models

• The highest Mercedes-Benz standard: Optimum interaction between vehicle, tires and road surface

• Optimum grip and traction

Our MO seal of approval for your tires.

Mercedes Original-Tires are developed by premium tire manufacturers to the highest Mercedes-Benz quality standards. Only tires that meet more than 40 defined parameters receive the corresponding MO quality seal. To do this, manufacturers must be able, among other things, to change various crucial points on the tire if necessary:


 

 

Tread

The tread provides contact with the road surface.

 

0° stabiliser belt

The 0° stabiliser belt ensures tires remain stable, even at high speeds.

 

Steel belt

The steel belt ensures stability, prevents warping and even minimises wear.

 

Carcass

The carcass is the supporting framework: it provides comfort and removes the need for tire savers.

 

Side wall

The side wall protects the carcass from exterior damage and environmental impact.

 

Bead

The tire bead ensures that the tires are sitting securely on the wheel rims, enabling you to steer with precision.
